factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'During the year... reducing CO2-related emissions by approximately 161,000 (124,000) tonnes.' Sustainability section confirms 161,000 tonnes for 2025.

factual_claims.claim: The company’s operating profit, or EBIT, improved substantially by 21.1 percent to SEK 73.5 million, compared to SEK 60.7 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, an increase of 21.1 percent compared with the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: This increase reflects the successful execution of the company’s strategy to build a portfolio of high-quality solar installations with stable revenue streams.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Operating profit for the full year increased to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million, driven by stable operations and improved underlying profitability... result of several years of systematic work building a portfolio of high-quality solar installations.'

factual_claims.claim: The EBIT margin expanded to 31 percent from 28 percent in the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview table: EBIT% for 2025 is 31%, compared to 28% in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Gross profit also grew to SEK 195.8 million, maintaining a stable gross margin of 82 percent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: Gross profit for 2025 is 195,829 thousand SEK (2024: 179,219). Gross margin% is 82% for both years.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA increased to SEK 163.7 million, with an EBITDA margin of 68 percent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview table: EBITDA for 2025 is 163,733 thousand SEK (2024: 145,760). EBITDA% is 68% (2024: 67%).

factual_claims.claim: Despite the strong operational results, the company reported a net loss for the period of SEK -7.2 million, a significant improvement from the net loss of SEK -32.9 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million.'

factual_claims.claim: The reported loss was negatively impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 million and a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The exchange rate difference amounted to SEK -3.8 (1.8) million... Profit for the year amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million.'

factual_claims.claim: When adjusted for these items, the profit amounted to SEK 0.1 million, demonstrating a clear improvement in core operational profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Adjusted for the currency effect and the one-off item, profit amounted to SEK 0.1 (-34.7) million, a clear improvement demonstrating that our core operations are now profitable.'

factual_claims.claim: The earnings per share improved to -0.13 SEK from -0.58 SEK in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement: 'Earnings per share for the period after dilution, SEK: -0.13 (2024: -0.58)'

factual_claims.claim: Several strategic and market events influenced these financial outcomes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report and CEO Comments discuss refinancing, SOLT4 extension, and market conditions in China as key influences.

factual_claims.claim: The company continued a refinancing program with Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd, which secured new financing of SEK 372 million in addition to previous agreements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The company has entered into an agreement with the Chinese company Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance an additional SEK 372 million (CNY 280 million).'

factual_claims.claim: This refinancing, featuring an interest rate of 3.60 percent and an extended amortization period, has begun to reduce interest expenses, which totaled SEK 76.9 million, down from SEK 84.2 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'Interest expenses and similar profit/loss items amounted to SEK 82.0 (88.7) million... The refinancing in China with Agricultural Bank continues to reduce interest expenses... Interest expenses and similar profit/loss items amounted to SEK 76,944 (84,165) thousand.'

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, the SOLT4 bond was extended to November 2026, providing greater financial flexibility.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'The bond SOLT4 was extended in accordance with the company’s request, which means that the last day for repayment of the bond is postponed to 8 November 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: Market conditions in China also played a role.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments and Board of Directors’ Report discuss electricity tariff adjustments in Jiangsu and Anhui provinces as a market condition affecting revenue.

factual_claims.claim: Electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted in the second half of the year, reducing the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'During mid-2025, electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted... reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent in the second half of the year compared with the same period the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: The company assesses that the impact on its existing project portfolio is manageable, amounting to a 3–4 percent reduction in revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'We assess that the impact on our existing project portfolio is manageable and amounts to approximately a 3–4 percent reduction in revenue.'

factual_claims.claim: However, structural cost improvements, including lower financing costs and declining construction costs for new projects, are expected to offset the lower average revenue per kWh.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO Comments: 'Structural cost improvements such as lower financing costs and lower construction costs are expected to clearly offset the lower average revenue per kWh.'

factual_claims.claim: The company installed 55.7 MW of new capacity during the year, bringing the total installed capacity to 395.8 MW.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'In 2025, the company installed a total of 55.7 (57.5) MW of roof-based solar energy facilities and had 395.8 (340.1) MW installed and revenue-generating capacity at the end of the year.'

factual_claims.claim: Signed orders stood at 16.4 MW at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Board of Directors’ Report: 'At the end of 2025, the company had 18.9 (38.8) MW in signed orders.' Note: The candidate refers to 'signed orders' as 16.4 MW, which aligns with the 'signed orders' figure in the Key Performance Indicators table (16.4 MW vs 38.8 MW previous year).

factual_claims.claim: The equity ratio decreased to 21 percent from 23 percent, primarily due to the accumulated losses and currency translation effects, though the rolling twelve-month equity ratio remained at 22 percent.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Multi-year overview table: Equity ratio for 2025 is 21% (2024: 23%). Equity ratio, rolling 12 months for 2025 is 22% (2024: 25%). Board of Directors’ Report mentions accumulated losses and currency effects as factors.

factual_claims.claim: The company maintains its long-term target of reaching 1,000 MW of installed capacity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy section: 'Gigasun maintains its long-term target of reaching 1,000 MW of installed capacity.'
